properties.lineage: Uncompahgre Park as excepted from the 1873 Brunot cession and returned to the Ute reservation by the Executive Order of Aug. 17, 1876 (Kappler I; Royce Schedule p. 886): 'Commencing at the fifty-third mile-post on the north line of the survey of the boundaries of the Ute cession, executed by James W. Miller in 1875; thence south 4 miles; thence east 4 miles; thence north 4 miles, to the said north line; thence west to the place of beginning' (4 miles square = 16 sq mi = 10,240 acres; ICC Docket 327, 11 Ind. Cl. Comm. 180, 263). Geometry: the notch Royce's Colorado map 1 (as digitized by USFS) leaves in the north line of area 566, vertices copied from data/derived/cessions.json and closed along that north line, so it fills the hole in 566 exactly. As drawn it is about 4.2 x 5.4 miles (about 14,900 acres), larger than the text's 10,240 acres; Miller's 1875 survey line itself is not available. Location error about 1-2 miles.
